instruction: Use LibreOffice Writer to join every .txt file from the VSCode workspace directory into 'centered_doc.docx' on Desktop, centering all text and omitting separators.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5)
